affected_subject.reason: Identifies TrustBonding._getPersonalUtilizationRatio and MultiVault.getUserUtilizationInEpoch as affected functions.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: user active in epoch-1 and inactive in current epoch, causing getUserUtilizationInEpoch to return same value for both.

direct_effect.reason: rawUtilizationDelta becomes 0, penalizing engaged users to 25% floor and losing 75% of rewards.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected 100% eligible rewards vs actual 25% floor due to <= vs < comparison, contradicting intended incentive design.

summary: All four dimensions are supported: affected functions, concrete trigger condition, direct reward penalty effect, and expected-vs-actual safety relation from the comparison bug.
